sentences.text: Khevender Daga & Anr vs Unknown on 11 June, 2024

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
 24
11-06-2024
Ct. No.34 b.das Crr No. 943 of 2024 + Cran 1 of 2024 In the matter of : Khevender Daga & Anr.
..... petitioners.

Ms. Diksha Ghosh Ms.
Swastika Chowdhury ...for opposite party.
Report submitted by the State is taken on record.

It appears from the statement of the de facto complainant which is part of the report that she has no grievance against the petitioners and does not intend to proceed with the matter any further in view of the amicable settlement arrived at between the parties.
Since the dispute has been amicably settled between the parties, continuation of the proceedings shall be a futile exercise.

The proceeding pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bidhannagar, North 24 Parganas being GR Case no 469 of 2021 arising out of Laketown Police Station Case No.103 of 2021 dated 1 st June, 2021 under Sections 498A/323/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code be quashed.
